--!strict

local CornLayout = {
	Height = 8,
	Spacing = 3,
	Seed = 817,
	ChunkCells = 12,
	RenderRadius = 150,
	ElevatedRadius = 200,
	DenseRadius = 60,
	MediumRadius = 130,
}

export type Plant = Model | BasePart
export type Box = { Frame: CFrame, HalfSize: Vector2 }
export type Circle = { Center: Vector3, Radius: number }
export type TrailEdge = {
	CenterX: number,
	CenterZ: number,
	HalfWidth: number,
	HalfLength: number,
	AlongX: boolean,
	Key: string,
}
export type Exclusions = {
	Boxes: { Box },
	Circles: { Circle },
	Signature: string,
	TrailEdges: { TrailEdge }?,
	TrailEdgeMaxShift: number?,
}

local SLOT_RADIUS = 6
local BOX_PADDING = 1.5
local DETAILED_SPACING_SCALE = 1 / math.sqrt(2.6)
local TRAIL_EDGE_OUTSET = 0.05

local function finite(value: number): boolean
	return value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge
end

function CornLayout.Bounds(plant: Plant): (CFrame, Vector3)
	if plant:IsA("Model") then
		return plant:GetBoundingBox()
	end
	return plant.CFrame, plant.Size
end

function CornLayout.PrepareTemplate(source: Instance, height: number?): (Plant?, string?)
	if not source:IsA("Model") and not source:IsA("BasePart") then
		return nil, "Corn source must be a Model or BasePart"
	end
	local targetHeight = height or CornLayout.Height
	if not finite(targetHeight) or targetHeight <= 0 then
		return nil, "Corn height must be positive and finite"
	end
	local items = source:GetDescendants()
	table.insert(items, source)
	local partCount = 0
	for _, item in items do
		if item:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
			return nil, "Corn source contains code"
		end
		if
			item:IsA("Sound")
			or item:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
			or item:IsA("Beam")
			or item:IsA("Trail")
			or item:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
			or item:IsA("ClickDetector")
			or item:IsA("RemoteEvent")
			or item:IsA("RemoteFunction")
		then
			return nil, "Corn source must contain only static art"
		end
		if not item.Archivable then
			return nil, "Corn source has non-Archivable contents"
		end
		if item:IsA("BasePart") then
			partCount += 1
		end
	end
	if partCount == 0 then
		return nil, "Corn source has no BaseParts"
	end

	local prepared = source:Clone() :: Plant?
	if not prepared then
		return nil, "Corn source could not be cloned"
	end
	local ok, problem = pcall(function()
		local _, size = CornLayout.Bounds(prepared :: Plant)
		if not finite(size.Y) or size.Y <= 0 then
			error("Corn source has no usable height")
		end
		local ratio = targetHeight / size.Y
		if prepared:IsA("Model") then
			prepared:ScaleTo(prepared:GetScale() * ratio)
		else
			prepared.Size *= ratio
			for _, item in prepared:GetChildren() do
				if item:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
					item.Scale *= ratio
				end
			end
		end
		-- The imported plant has one mesh plus import poses/animation metadata.
		-- Keep only that normalized mesh on decorative copies; the source is untouched.
		if prepared:IsA("Model") and partCount == 1 then
			local mesh = prepared:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("MeshPart", true)
			if mesh and mesh:IsA("MeshPart") then
				mesh.Parent = nil
				prepared:Destroy()
				prepared = mesh
			end
		end
		for _, item in prepared:GetDescendants() do
			if
				item:IsA("AnimationController")
				or (item:IsA("Folder") and item.Name == "InitialPoses")
			then
				item:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local clones = prepared:GetDescendants()
		table.insert(clones, prepared)
		for _, item in clones do
			-- Art tags must not become gameplay bindings on every decorative clone.
			for _, tag in item:GetTags() do
				item:RemoveTag(tag)
			end
			if item:IsA("BasePart") then
				item.Anchored = true
				item.CanCollide = false
				item.CanTouch = false
				item.CanQuery = false
				item.CastShadow = false
				if item:IsA("MeshPart") then
					item.DoubleSided = true
				end
			end
		end
		prepared:PivotTo(CornLayout.PivotForPlant(prepared, Vector3.zero, 0))
	end)
	if not ok then
		prepared:Destroy()
		return nil, tostring(problem)
	end
	return prepared, nil
end

function CornLayout.PivotForPlant(plant: Plant, groundPosition: Vector3, yaw: number): CFrame
	local bounds, size = CornLayout.Bounds(plant)
	local boundsFromPivot = plant:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace(bounds)
	return CFrame.new(groundPosition + Vector3.new(0, size.Y / 2, 0))
		* CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
		* boundsFromPivot:Inverse()
end

function CornLayout.SpacingFor(field: BasePart): number
	local map = field.Parent
	if
		field.Name == "FieldZone"
		and map
		and map:IsA("Model")
		and map.Name == "CornMap"
		and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
		and map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"
	then
		return CornLayout.Spacing * DETAILED_SPACING_SCALE
	end
	return CornLayout.Spacing
end

function CornLayout.GetCellBounds(field: BasePart): (number, number, number, number)
	local half = field.Size / 2
	local spacing = CornLayout.SpacingFor(field)
	return math.ceil(-half.X / spacing),
		math.floor(half.X / spacing),
		math.ceil(-half.Z / spacing),
		math.floor(half.Z / spacing)
end

function CornLayout.BaseCellPosition(field: BasePart, column: number, row: number): Vector3
	local half = field.Size / 2
	local spacing = CornLayout.SpacingFor(field)
	local hashX = (column * 92837111 + row * 689287499 + CornLayout.Seed) % 104729
	local hashZ = (column * 19349663 + row * 83492791 + CornLayout.Seed) % 104729
	local stagger = if row % 2 == 0 then -spacing * 0.15 else spacing * 0.15
	local x = column * spacing + stagger + (hashX / 104729 - 0.5) * spacing * 0.12
	local z = row * spacing + (hashZ / 104729 - 0.5) * spacing * 0.12
	return field.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(
		Vector3.new(math.clamp(x, -half.X, half.X), -half.Y, math.clamp(z, -half.Z, half.Z))
	)
end

local function hash(column: number, row: number, salt: number): number
	return ((column * 73856093 + row * 19349663 + CornLayout.Seed * salt) % 104729) / 104729
end

function CornLayout.CellPosition(field: BasePart, column: number, row: number): Vector3
	local point = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(CornLayout.BaseCellPosition(field, column, row))
	local half = field.Size / 2
	local spacing = CornLayout.SpacingFor(field)
	return field.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(
		Vector3.new(
			math.clamp(point.X + (hash(column, row, 17) * 2 - 1) * spacing * 0.1, -half.X, half.X),
			point.Y,
			math.clamp(point.Z + (hash(column, row, 31) * 2 - 1) * spacing * 0.1, -half.Z, half.Z)
		)
	)
end

function CornLayout.CellYaw(column: number, row: number): number
	local sign = if hash(column, row, 47) < 0.5 then -1 else 1
	return math.rad(10 + hash(column, row, 61) * 20) * sign
end

function CornLayout.HeightFactor(column: number, row: number): number
	local sign = if hash(column, row, 79) < 0.5 then -1 else 1
	return 1 + sign * (0.1 + hash(column, row, 97) * 0.05)
end

function CornLayout.ApplyVariation(plant: Plant, column: number, row: number)
	local factor = CornLayout.HeightFactor(column, row)
	if plant:IsA("BasePart") then
		plant.Size = Vector3.new(plant.Size.X, plant.Size.Y * factor, plant.Size.Z)
	else
		plant:ScaleTo(plant:GetScale() * factor)
	end
end

local function footprint(frame: CFrame, size: Vector3, padding: number): Box
	local look = frame.LookVector
	local yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
	local flat = CFrame.new(frame.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
	local half = size / 2
	local right = flat.RightVector
	local forward = flat.LookVector
	local width = math.abs(right:Dot(frame.RightVector)) * half.X
		+ math.abs(right:Dot(frame.UpVector)) * half.Y
		+ math.abs(right:Dot(frame.LookVector)) * half.Z
	local depth = math.abs(forward:Dot(frame.RightVector)) * half.X
		+ math.abs(forward:Dot(frame.UpVector)) * half.Y
		+ math.abs(forward:Dot(frame.LookVector)) * half.Z
	return { Frame = flat, HalfSize = Vector2.new(width + padding, depth + padding) }
end

local function authorDescendants(map: Model): { Instance }
	local result: { Instance } = {}
	local stack = map:GetChildren()
	while #stack > 0 do
		local item = table.remove(stack)
		local owned = item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
		local decoration = owned
			and (
				(item.Name == "EditorPreview" and item:GetAttribute("CornEditorPreview") == true)
				or (item.Name == "EditorFieldOverview" and item:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true)
				or (item.Name == "CornClientPlants" and item:GetAttribute("CornClientRendererOwned") == true)
				or (item.Name == "CornClientBackdrop" and item:GetAttribute(
					"CornClientBackdropOwned"
				) == true)
				or item.Name == "CornRoundRuntime"
			)
		if decoration then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(result, item)
		for _, child in item:GetChildren() do
			table.insert(stack, child)
		end
	end
	return result
end
function CornLayout.ReadExclusions(map: Model, field: BasePart): Exclusions
	local boxes: { Box } = {}
	local circles: { Circle } = {}
	local trailEdges: { TrailEdge } = {}
	local signatures: { string } = { tostring(field.CFrame) .. "/" .. tostring(field.Size) }
	local included: { [Instance]: boolean } = {}
	local detailed = CornLayout.SpacingFor(field) ~= CornLayout.Spacing
	local noCorn = map:FindFirstChild("NoCornZones")
	local maze = if noCorn then noCorn:FindFirstChild("Maze02Masks") else nil
	local function ownedTrail(part: BasePart): boolean
		local index = tonumber(part.Name:match("^trail_(%d%d%d)$"))
		return detailed
			and map == field.Parent
			and maze ~= nil
			and maze:IsA("Folder")
			and maze:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
			and maze:GetAttribute("CornMazeOwner") == "corn_maze02_v1"
			and part.Parent == maze
			and part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
			and part:GetAttribute("CornMazeOwner") == "corn_maze02_v1"
			and index ~= nil
			and index >= 1
			and index <= 100
			and math.abs(part.Size.Y - 0.08) < 0.001
			and math.min(part.Size.X, part.Size.Z) == 4
			and math.max(part.Size.X, part.Size.Z) >= 30
			and part.CFrame.Rotation == CFrame.identity
	end
	local function addBox(part: BasePart, padding: number)
		if included[part] then
			return
		end
		included[part] = true
		local trail = ownedTrail(part)
		if trail then
			-- The visible four-stud path is the root clearance. Fixed props keep
			-- their existing safety margin; leaves may reach over the path edge.
			padding = 0
		end
		local box = footprint(part.CFrame, part.Size, padding)
		table.insert(boxes, box)
		if trail then
			local center = part.CFrame.Position
			table.insert(trailEdges, {
				CenterX = center.X,
				CenterZ = center.Z,
				HalfWidth = math.min(part.Size.X, part.Size.Z) / 2,
				HalfLength = math.max(part.Size.X, part.Size.Z) / 2,
				AlongX = part.Size.X > part.Size.Z,
				Key = part.Name,
			})
		end
		table.insert(
			signatures,
			part:GetFullName()
				.. "/box/"
				.. tostring(part.CFrame)
				.. "/"
				.. tostring(part.Size)
				.. "/"
				.. padding
		)
	end
	for _, folderName in { "NoCornZones", "Props" } do
		local folder = map:FindFirstChild(folderName)
		if folder then
			for _, item in folder:GetDescendants() do
				if item:IsA("BasePart") then
					addBox(item, BOX_PADDING)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, item in authorDescendants(map) do
		if item:IsA("BasePart") then
			if item:HasTag("corn_no_corn_zone") then
				addBox(item, BOX_PADDING)
			end
			if item:HasTag("corn_key_slot") then
				table.insert(circles, { Center = item.Position, Radius = SLOT_RADIUS })
				table.insert(signatures, item:GetFullName() .. "/slot/" .. tostring(item.Position))
			elseif item:HasTag("corn_spawn") then
				addBox(item, 4)
				table.insert(circles, { Center = item.Position, Radius = 10 })
				table.insert(signatures, item:GetFullName() .. "/spawn/" .. tostring(item.Position))
			end
		end
	end
	local gate = map:FindFirstChild("EscapeGate")
	if gate then
		local door = gate:FindFirstChild("Door", true)
		if door and door:IsA("BasePart") then
			addBox(door, 6)
		end
	end
	table.sort(signatures)
	table.sort(trailEdges, function(a, b)
		return a.Key < b.Key
	end)
	return {
		Boxes = boxes,
		Circles = circles,
		Signature = table.concat(signatures, "|"),
		TrailEdges = trailEdges,
		TrailEdgeMaxShift = CornLayout.SpacingFor(field),
	}
end

function CornLayout.IsExcluded(position: Vector3, exclusions: Exclusions): boolean
	for _, circle in exclusions.Circles do
		local delta = position - circle.Center
		if delta.X * delta.X + delta.Z * delta.Z <= circle.Radius * circle.Radius then
			return true
		end
	end
	for _, box in exclusions.Boxes do
		local localPosition = box.Frame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
		if
			math.abs(localPosition.X) <= box.HalfSize.X
			and math.abs(localPosition.Z) <= box.HalfSize.Y
		then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function CornLayout.TrailEdgePosition(position: Vector3, exclusions: Exclusions): Vector3
	local edges = exclusions.TrailEdges
	local reach = exclusions.TrailEdgeMaxShift
	if not edges or #edges == 0 or not reach then
		return position
	end
	local bestGap = math.huge
	local x, z = position.X, position.Z
	local candidateX, candidateZ = x, z
	local found = false
	for _, edge in edges do
		local dx, dz = x - edge.CenterX, z - edge.CenterZ
		local across = if edge.AlongX then dz else dx
		local along = if edge.AlongX then dx else dz
		local gap = math.abs(across) - edge.HalfWidth
		if
			gap >= 0
			and gap <= reach
			and gap < bestGap
			and math.abs(along) <= edge.HalfLength - 1
		then
			bestGap = gap
			local target = (if across < 0 then -1 else 1) * (edge.HalfWidth + TRAIL_EDGE_OUTSET)
			candidateX = if edge.AlongX then x else edge.CenterX + target
			candidateZ = if edge.AlongX then edge.CenterZ + target else z
			found = true
		end
	end
	-- Reuse existing cells, variants and render budgets. Both the original and
	-- projected root must pass every clearance, including crossing paths.
	local candidate = if found then Vector3.new(candidateX, position.Y, candidateZ) else nil
	if
		candidate
		and not CornLayout.IsExcluded(position, exclusions)
		and not CornLayout.IsExcluded(candidate, exclusions)
	then
		return candidate
	end
	return position
end

return CornLayout

--!strict

-- Both atlases use the original mesh UVs; the imported green art stays intact.
local detailedTemplates = nil
local detailedBuilding = false
local TEMPLATE_PROPERTIES = {
	"CFrame",
	"Size",
	"PivotOffset",
	"TextureID",
	"TextureContent",
	"Color",
	"Material",
	"MaterialVariant",
	"Transparency",
	"Reflectance",
	"Anchored",
	"CanCollide",
	"CanTouch",
	"CanQuery",
	"CastShadow",
	"DoubleSided",
	"CollisionGroup",
	"Massless",
	"CustomPhysicalProperties",
}
local CornAppearance = {
	MeshId = "rbxassetid://104111861186519",
	GreenTextureId = "rbxassetid://137803536172445",
	DryTextureId = "rbxassetid://103653296385119",
	DetailedNearChunkLimit = 8,
	DetailedNearPlantLimit = 1152,
	DetailedHeight = 10,
}

function CornAppearance.Variety(column: number, row: number): number
	-- Keep the same shape at every detail level, including the even backdrop grid.
	return ((column * 73856093 + row * 19349663 + 817) % 104729) % 4 + 1
end

function CornAppearance.IsDetailedMap(map: Instance?): boolean
	return map ~= nil
		and map:IsA("Model")
		and map.Name == "CornMap"
		and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
		and map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"
end

function CornAppearance.DetailedKey(variety: number, lod: string): string
	assert(variety >= 1 and variety <= 4 and variety % 1 == 0, "Corn variety must be 1..4")
	assert(lod == "Near" or lod == "Mid" or lod == "Far", "Unknown corn geometry LOD")
	return "Corn_" .. string.char(64 + variety) .. "_" .. lod
end

function CornAppearance.IsDetailedPlant(part: Instance, variety: number, lod: string): boolean
	return part:IsA("MeshPart")
		and part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
		and part:GetAttribute("HarvestGeometryOwner") == "harvest_warden_v1"
		and part:GetAttribute("HarvestAssetKey") == CornAppearance.DetailedKey(variety, lod)
		and part.Anchored
		and part.Archivable
		and not part.CanCollide
		and not part.CanTouch
		and not part.CanQuery
end

function CornAppearance.DetailedPivot(plant: BasePart, position: Vector3, yaw: number): CFrame
	local offset = plant:GetAttribute("HarvestRootOffset")
	assert(typeof(offset) == "Vector3", "Detailed corn root offset required")
	local varied = Vector3.new(offset.X, offset.Y * plant.Size.Y / 8, offset.Z)
	return CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.new(varied)
end

function CornAppearance.DetailedTemplates(): any
	while detailedBuilding do
		task.wait()
	end
	if detailedTemplates then
		return detailedTemplates
	end
	-- EditableMesh content cannot cast shadows. Bake only the private B render
	-- templates into session-scoped static content; catalog/world art stays intact.
	detailedBuilding = true
	local created: { MeshPart } = {}
	local carriers: { MeshPart } = {}
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		local assetService = game:GetService("AssetService")
		local geometry = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("HarvestArtGeometry"))
		local templates = {}
		local seen: { [Instance]: boolean } = {}
		for _, lod in { "Near", "Mid", "Far" } do
			templates[lod] = {}
			for variety = 1, 4 do
				local part = geometry.CornTemplate(variety, lod)
				assert(
					CornAppearance.IsDetailedPlant(part, variety, lod)
						and part:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") == true
						and math.abs(part.Size.Y - 8) < 0.001
						and typeof(part:GetAttribute("HarvestRootOffset")) == "Vector3"
						and part.PivotOffset == CFrame.identity
						and not seen[part],
					"Unknown detailed corn template binding"
				)
				seen[part] = true
				local preserved = {}
				for _, name in TEMPLATE_PROPERTIES do
					preserved[name] = (part :: any)[name]
				end
				local contentResult, content =
					assetService:CreateDataModelContentAsync(part.MeshContent)
				assert(
					contentResult == Enum.CreateContentResult.Success
						and content.SourceType == Enum.ContentSourceType.Opaque,
					"Static corn geometry unavailable: " .. tostring(contentResult)
				)
				local carrier = assert(
					assetService:CreateMeshPartAsync(content, {
						CollisionFidelity = part.CollisionFidelity,
						RenderFidelity = part.RenderFidelity,
					}),
					"Static corn MeshPart unavailable"
				)
				table.insert(carriers, carrier)
				-- Keep immutable catalog geometry at eight studs. Only the personal
				-- B render template grows vertically; rooted placement scales its Y.
				local taller = assert(part:Clone(), "Private corn template unavailable")
				table.insert(created, taller)
				taller:ApplyMesh(carrier)
				-- ApplyMesh also replaces texture/pose-related properties. Restore the
				-- exact original atlas Content after TextureID, including empty values.
				for _, name in TEMPLATE_PROPERTIES do
					(taller :: any)[name] = preserved[name]
				end
				assert(
					taller.MeshContent == content
						and taller.CollisionFidelity == part.CollisionFidelity
						and taller.RenderFidelity == part.RenderFidelity,
					"Static corn geometry binding changed"
				)
				taller.Size = Vector3.new(part.Size.X, CornAppearance.DetailedHeight, part.Size.Z)
				templates[lod][variety] = taller
			end
		end
		return templates
	end)
	for _, carrier in carriers do
		carrier:Destroy()
	end
	detailedBuilding = false
	if not ok then
		for _, part in created do
			part:Destroy()
		end
	end
	assert(ok, tostring(result))
	detailedTemplates = result
	return result
end

function CornAppearance.IsDry(mode: string?): boolean
	-- Ready/menu already show the only playable night field.
	return mode == nil or mode == "medium" or mode == "hard"
end

function CornAppearance.IsValidMode(mode: any): boolean
	return mode == nil or mode == "easy" or mode == "medium" or mode == "hard"
end

return table.freeze(CornAppearance)

function CornController:_warn(message: string)
	if self._lastWarning ~= message then
		self._lastWarning = message
		warn("[CornController] " .. message)
	end
end

local function overviewKeys(field: BasePart, part: BasePart): { string }
	local relative = field.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
	local half = part.Size / 2
	local spacing = CornLayout.SpacingFor(field)
	-- Require completed fine groups across the entire rotated coarse footprint.
	-- The margin also covers the small deterministic cell stagger.
	local padding = spacing * 0.75
	local halfX = math.abs(relative.RightVector.X) * half.X
		+ math.abs(relative.UpVector.X) * half.Y
		+ math.abs(relative.LookVector.X) * half.Z
		+ padding
	local halfZ = math.abs(relative.RightVector.Z) * half.X
		+ math.abs(relative.UpVector.Z) * half.Y
		+ math.abs(relative.LookVector.Z) * half.Z
		+ padding
	local fieldHalf = field.Size / 2
	local minX = math.max(relative.Position.X - halfX, -fieldHalf.X)
	local maxX = math.min(relative.Position.X + halfX, fieldHalf.X)
	local minZ = math.max(relative.Position.Z - halfZ, -fieldHalf.Z)
	local maxZ = math.min(relative.Position.Z + halfZ, fieldHalf.Z)
	local keys: { string } = {}
	if minX > maxX or minZ > maxZ then
		return keys
	end
	local width = spacing * CornLayout.ChunkCells
	local offset = spacing / 2
	for column = math.floor((minX + offset) / width), math.floor((maxX + offset) / width) do
		for row = math.floor((minZ + offset) / width), math.floor((maxZ + offset) / width) do
			table.insert(keys, column .. ":" .. row)
		end
	end
	return keys
end

function CornController:_showOverview()
	for _, entry in self._overviewParts do
		if entry.Hidden then
			if entry.Part.Parent then
				entry.Part.LocalTransparencyModifier = entry.PreviousModifier
			end
			entry.Hidden = false
		end
	end
	self._overviewDirty = {}
end

function CornController:_invalidateOverview()
	if self._overviewInvalid then
		return
	end
	self._overviewInvalid = true
	-- A changed footprint or ownership must never keep an old local coverage mask.
	self:_showOverview()
	self._pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
end

function CornController:_restoreOverview()
	for _, connection in self._overviewConnections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._overviewConnections)
	self._overviewInvalid = true
	self:_showOverview()
	self._overviewFolder = nil
	self._overviewRuntime = false
	self._overviewParts = {}
	self._overviewByChunk = {}
end

function CornController:_markOverviewChunk(key: string)
	for _, entry in self._overviewByChunk[key] or {} do
		self._overviewDirty[entry] = true
	end
end

local function ownedBackdrop(folder: Instance?, map: Model?): boolean
	return folder ~= nil
		and map ~= nil
		and folder:IsA("Folder")
		and folder.Name == "CornClientBackdrop"
		and folder.Parent == map
		and folder:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") == true
		and folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
		and folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
end

function CornController:UseBackdropReady(folder: Folder): boolean
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or not ownedBackdrop(folder, map)
	then
		return false
	end
	-- The backdrop calls this before capturing authored visibility and publishing Ready.
	-- It also calls it before releasing the runtime layer, while ownership is intact.
	self:_restoreOverview()
	self._pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
	return true
end

function CornController:_bindOverview()
	local map = self._map
	local field = self._field
	local folder = if map then map:FindFirstChild("EditorFieldOverview") else nil
	local backdrop = if map then map:FindFirstChild("CornClientBackdrop") else nil
	local runtime = ownedBackdrop(backdrop, map) and backdrop:GetAttribute("Ready") == true
	if runtime then
		folder = backdrop
	end
	if not folder then
		self:_restoreOverview()
		return
	end
	if
		not field
		or not folder:IsA("Folder")
		or folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
		or folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		self:_restoreOverview()
		self:_warn("Unrecognized EditorFieldOverview is preserved")
		return
	end
	if
		not self._overviewInvalid
		and self._overviewFolder == folder
		and self._overviewFieldFrame == field.CFrame
		and self._overviewFieldSize == field.Size
	then
		return -- Signals invalidate the index instead of scanning every saved plant every poll.
	end
	local children = folder:GetChildren()
	-- This pass does not yield or change visibility. The whole container must be owned.
	for _, item in children do
		if
			not item:IsA("BasePart")
			or item:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
			or item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_restoreOverview()
			self:_warn("EditorFieldOverview contains unowned objects; all were preserved")
			return
		end
	end
	self:_restoreOverview()
	self._overviewFolder = folder
	self._overviewRuntime = runtime
	self._overviewFieldFrame = field.CFrame
	self._overviewFieldSize = field.Size
	local function invalidate()
		self:_invalidateOverview()
	end
	local function watch(signal: RBXScriptSignal)
		table.insert(self._overviewConnections, signal:Connect(invalidate))
	end
	watch(folder.ChildAdded)
	watch(folder.ChildRemoved)
	watch(folder.AncestryChanged)
	watch(folder:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Name"))
	watch(folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CornEditorOverview"))
	watch(folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("corn_project_id"))
	if runtime then
		watch(folder.DescendantAdded)
		watch(folder.DescendantRemoving)
		watch(folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CornClientBackdropOwned"))
		watch(folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Ready"))
	end
	watch(field:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"))
	watch(field:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"))
	for _, item in children do
		local part = item :: BasePart
		local entry: OverviewItem = {
			Part = part,
			PreviousModifier = part.LocalTransparencyModifier,
			Frame = part.CFrame,
			Size = part.Size,
			Keys = overviewKeys(field, part),
			Hidden = false,
		}
		self._overviewParts[part] = entry
		for _, key in entry.Keys do
			local items = self._overviewByChunk[key]
			if not items then
				items = {}
				self._overviewByChunk[key] = items
			end
			table.insert(items, entry)
		end
		-- The backdrop owns immutable client-only copies; authored overview stays editable.
		if not runtime then
			watch(part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"))
			watch(part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"))
			watch(part:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CornEditorOverview"))
			watch(part:GetAttributeChangedSignal("corn_project_id"))
		end
	end
	self._overviewInvalid = false
	for key, chunk in self._chunks do
		if chunk.Done then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(key)
		end
	end
end

function CornController:_updateOverview()
	local folder = self._overviewFolder
	if not folder or self._overviewInvalid then
		return
	end
	if
		folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
		or folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or (
			self._overviewRuntime
			and (not ownedBackdrop(folder, self._map) or folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true)
		)
	then
		self:_restoreOverview()
		return
	end
	for entry in self._overviewDirty do
		local part = entry.Part
		if
			part.Parent ~= folder
			or part:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
			or part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_restoreOverview()
			self:_warn("Overview ownership changed; its visibility was restored")
			return
		end
		local covered = #entry.Keys > 0
		for _, key in entry.Keys do
			local chunk = self._chunks[key]
			if not chunk or not chunk.Done or (self._overviewRuntime and chunk.Lod > 2) then
				covered = false
				break
			end
		end
		if covered ~= entry.Hidden then
			part.LocalTransparencyModifier = if covered then 1 else entry.PreviousModifier
			entry.Hidden = covered
		end
	end
	self._overviewDirty = {}
end

function CornController:_clearChunks()
	self:_showOverview()
	for _, chunk in self._chunks do
		chunk.Alive = false
		chunk.Folder:Destroy()
	end
	self._chunks = {}
	self._queue = {}
	self._plantCount = 0
	if self._folder then
		self._folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	end
end

function CornController:_clearInputs()
	self._inputEpoch = (self._inputEpoch or 0) + 1
	self:_clearChunks()
	self:_restoreOverview()
	if self._folder then
		self._folder:Destroy()
	end
	self._folder = nil
	self._map = nil
	self._field = nil
	self._template = nil
	self._exclusions = nil
	self._elevatedUntil = nil
	self._detailed = false
	self._detailedTemplates = nil
end

function CornController:_resolveInputs(): boolean
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	local field = if map then map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone") else nil
	local art = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CornRuntimeArt")
	local template = if art then art:FindFirstChild("CornPlantTemplate") else nil
	if not map or not map:IsA("Model") or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("The owned CornMap is not available; editor preview is preserved")
		return false
	end
	if
		not field
		or not field:IsA("BasePart")
		or field.CFrame.UpVector:Dot(Vector3.yAxis) < 0.9999
	then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("CornMap needs a horizontal FieldZone; editor preview is preserved")
		return false
	end
	if
		not art
		or not art:IsA("Folder")
		or art:GetAttribute("CornRuntimeArtOwned") ~= true
		or art:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or not template
		or (not template:IsA("Model") and not template:IsA("BasePart"))
		or template:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
	then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("Prepared corn art is not available; check CornField Output")
		return false
	end
	local detailed = map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"
	if
		self._map == map
		and self._field == field
		and self._template == template
		and self._folder
		and (self._detailed == true) == detailed
	then
		return true
	end
	local templates, appearance = nil, nil
	if detailed then
		if self._detailPreparing then
			return false
		end
		self._detailPreparing = true
		local epoch = self._inputEpoch
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			local module = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("CornAppearance"))
			return { Appearance = module, Templates = module.DetailedTemplates() }
		end)
		self._detailPreparing = false
		if
			self._inputEpoch ~= epoch
			or not map.Parent
			or map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") ~= "B"
		then
			return false
		end
		if not ok then
			self:_warn("Detailed corn unavailable; editor overview preserved: " .. tostring(result))
			return false
		end
		templates, appearance = result.Templates, result.Appearance
	end
	self:_clearInputs()
	local existing = map:FindFirstChild("CornClientPlants")
	if existing then
		if
			not existing:IsA("Folder")
			or existing:GetAttribute("CornClientRendererOwned") ~= true
			or existing:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_warn("Refused to replace unowned CornMap/CornClientPlants")
			return false
		end
		existing:Destroy()
	end
	local bounds, size = CornLayout.Bounds(template)
	self._pivotOffset = template:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace(bounds):Inverse()
	self._height = size.Y
	self._map = map
	self._field = field
	self._template = template
	self._detailed = detailed
	self._detailedTemplates = templates
	self._appearance = appearance
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "CornClientPlants"
	folder:SetAttribute("CornClientRendererOwned", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT_ID)
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	if detailed then
		folder:SetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant", "B")
		folder:SetAttribute("NearPlantCap", appearance.DetailedNearPlantLimit)
	end
	folder.Parent = map
	self._folder = folder
	-- This client-only deletion never changes the author's saved scene or Props.
	local preview = map:FindFirstChild("EditorPreview")
	if
		preview
		and preview:IsA("Folder")
		and preview:GetAttribute("CornEditorPreview") == true
		and preview:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
	then
		preview:Destroy()
	end
	self._lastWarning = ""
	return true
end

function CornController:_lodForDistance(
	distance: number,
	previous: number?,
	mediumRadius: number
): number
	local dense = CornLayout.DenseRadius
	if previous == 1 then
		if distance <= (dense + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	elseif previous == 2 then
		if distance <= (dense - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	elseif previous == 3 then
		if distance <= (dense - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	end
	return if distance <= dense ^ 2 then 1 elseif distance <= mediumRadius ^ 2 then 2 else 3
end

function CornController:_elevatedView(root: BasePart, now: number): boolean
	local field = self._field :: BasePart
	local rootHeight = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position).Y + field.Size.Y / 2
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	local cameraHeight = if camera
		then field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(camera.CFrame.Position).Y + field.Size.Y / 2
		else 0
	if math.max(rootHeight, cameraHeight) > 6 then
		self._elevatedUntil = now + 2
	end
	return now < (self._elevatedUntil or 0)
end

function CornController:_reconcile(root: BasePart)
	if not self:_resolveInputs() then
		return
	end
	local map = self._map :: Model
	local field = self._field :: BasePart
	local folder = self._folder :: Folder
	self:_bindOverview()
	local exclusions = CornLayout.ReadExclusions(map, field)
	if self._exclusions and self._exclusions.Signature ~= exclusions.Signature then
		self:_clearChunks()
	end
	self._exclusions = exclusions
	local minColumn, maxColumn, minRow, maxRow = CornLayout.GetCellBounds(field)
	local localRoot = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
	local spacing = CornLayout.SpacingFor(field)
	local width = spacing * CornLayout.ChunkCells
	local elevated = self:_elevatedView(root, os.clock())
	local radius = if elevated then CornLayout.ElevatedRadius else CornLayout.RenderRadius
	local mediumRadius = if elevated then ELEVATED_MEDIUM_RADIUS else CornLayout.MediumRadius
	local retainRadius = radius + RETAIN_MARGIN
	local backdrop = self._overviewFolder
	local backdropStride = if self._overviewRuntime and backdrop
		then backdrop:GetAttribute("DetailStride")
		else nil
	local backdropCoversSparse = typeof(backdropStride) == "number"
		and backdropStride <= spacing * 2
	folder:SetAttribute("ViewRadius", radius)
	folder:SetAttribute("ElevatedDetail", elevated)
	local desired: { any } = {}
	for chunkColumn = math.floor((localRoot.X - retainRadius) / width), math.floor((localRoot.X + retainRadius) / width) do
		for chunkRow = math.floor((localRoot.Z - retainRadius) / width), math.floor((localRoot.Z + retainRadius) / width) do
			local firstColumn = math.max(minColumn, chunkColumn * CornLayout.ChunkCells)
			local lastColumn = math.min(maxColumn, (chunkColumn + 1) * CornLayout.ChunkCells - 1)
			local firstRow = math.max(minRow, chunkRow * CornLayout.ChunkCells)
			local lastRow = math.min(maxRow, (chunkRow + 1) * CornLayout.ChunkCells - 1)
			if firstColumn > lastColumn or firstRow > lastRow then
				continue
			end
			local centerX = (firstColumn + lastColumn) * spacing / 2
			local centerZ = (firstRow + lastRow) * spacing / 2
			local distance = (centerX - localRoot.X) ^ 2 + (centerZ - localRoot.Z) ^ 2
			local key = chunkColumn .. ":" .. chunkRow
			local previous = self._chunks[key]
			if
				distance <= radius * radius
				or (previous and distance <= retainRadius * retainRadius)
			then
				local lod = self:_lodForDistance(
					distance,
					if previous then previous.Lod else nil,
					mediumRadius
				)
				if backdropCoversSparse and lod == 3 then
					continue -- Whole-field stride6 is already denser than sparse stride9.
				end
				table.insert(desired, {
					Key = key,
					Lod = lod,
					MinColumn = firstColumn,
					MaxColumn = lastColumn,
					MinRow = firstRow,
					MaxRow = lastRow,
					Distance = distance,
				})
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(desired, function(a, b)
		return if a.Distance == b.Distance then a.Key < b.Key else a.Distance < b.Distance
	end)
	local wanted: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	local nearChunks = 0
	local maxChunks = if self._detailed then DETAILED_MAX_CHUNKS else MAX_CHUNKS
	for index, candidate in desired do
		if index > maxChunks then
			break
		end
		wanted[candidate.Key] = true
		local artLod = candidate.Lod
		if self._detailed then
			if candidate.Lod == 1 then
				nearChunks += 1
			end
			artLod = if candidate.Lod == 1
					and nearChunks <= self._appearance.DetailedNearChunkLimit
				then 1
				elseif candidate.Lod <= 2 then 2
				else 3
		end
		local chunk = self._chunks[candidate.Key]
		if
			chunk and (chunk.Lod ~= candidate.Lod or (self._detailed and chunk.ArtLod ~= artLod))
		then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(chunk.Key)
			chunk.Alive = false
			self._plantCount -= chunk.Count
			chunk.Folder:Destroy()
			self._chunks[candidate.Key] = nil
			chunk = nil
		end
		if chunk then
			chunk.Distance = candidate.Distance
		else
			local chunkFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
			chunkFolder.Name = "Chunk_" .. candidate.Key
			chunkFolder:SetAttribute("DetailStride", candidate.Lod * spacing)
			if self._detailed then
				chunkFolder:SetAttribute("HarvestCornLod", ({ "Near", "Mid", "Far" })[artLod])
			end
			chunkFolder.Parent = folder
			chunk = {
				Key = candidate.Key,
				Lod = candidate.Lod,
				ArtLod = artLod,
				Folder = chunkFolder,
				MinColumn = candidate.MinColumn,
				MaxColumn = candidate.MaxColumn,
				MinRow = candidate.MinRow,
				MaxRow = candidate.MaxRow,
				Column = candidate.MinColumn,
				Row = candidate.MinRow,
				Distance = candidate.Distance,
				Count = 0,
				Alive = true,
				Done = false,
			}
			self._chunks[candidate.Key] = chunk
		end
	end
	for key, chunk in self._chunks do
		if not wanted[key] then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(key)
			chunk.Alive = false
			self._plantCount -= chunk.Count
			chunk.Folder:Destroy()
			self._chunks[key] = nil
		end
	end
	self._queue = {}
	for _, chunk in self._chunks do
		if not chunk.Done then
			table.insert(self._queue, chunk)
		end
	end
	table.sort(self._queue, function(a, b)
		return if a.Distance == b.Distance then a.Key < b.Key else a.Distance < b.Distance
	end)
	self:_updateOverview()
end

function CornController:_createBatch()
	local template = self._template
	local field = self._field
	local exclusions = self._exclusions
	if not template or not field or not exclusions then
		return
	end
	local began = os.clock()
	local _, fieldYaw = field.CFrame:ToOrientation()
	local examined = 0
	local created = 0
	local maxPlants = if self._detailed then DETAILED_MAX_PLANTS else MAX_PLANTS
	while
		#self._queue > 0
		and examined < CELL_BUDGET
		and created < CREATE_BUDGET
		and self._plantCount < maxPlants
		and os.clock() - began < TIME_BUDGET_SEC
	do
		local chunk = self._queue[1]
		if not chunk.Alive or chunk.Done then
			table.remove(self._queue, 1)
			continue
		end
		local column = chunk.Column
		local row = chunk.Row
		chunk.Column += 1
		if chunk.Column > chunk.MaxColumn then
			chunk.Column = chunk.MinColumn
			chunk.Row += 1
		end
		if chunk.Row > chunk.MaxRow then
			chunk.Done = true
			self:_markOverviewChunk(chunk.Key)
			table.remove(self._queue, 1)
		end
		examined += 1
		if column % chunk.Lod ~= 0 or row % chunk.Lod ~= 0 then
			continue
		end
		local position = CornLayout.CellPosition(field, column, row)
		if CornLayout.IsExcluded(position, exclusions) then
			continue
		end
		position = CornLayout.TrailEdgePosition(position, exclusions)
		local source = template
		if self._detailed then
			local lod = ({ "Near", "Mid", "Far" })[chunk.ArtLod or 3]
			local variety = self._appearance.Variety(column, row)
			source = self._detailedTemplates[lod][variety]
		end
		local clone = source:Clone()
		if not clone then
			self:_warn("Prepared corn template is not Archivable")
			self:Destroy()
			return
		end
		local plant = clone :: CornLayout.Plant
		plant.Name = "Corn"
		if self._detailed or chunk.Lod == 3 then
			local items = plant:GetDescendants()
			table.insert(items, plant)
			for _, item in items do
				if self._detailed and item:IsA("BasePart") then
					item.CastShadow = true
				elseif item:IsA("MeshPart") then
					item.CastShadow = false
				end
			end
		end
		CornLayout.ApplyVariation(plant, column, row)
		local yaw = CornLayout.CellYaw(column, row) + fieldYaw
		plant:PivotTo(
			if self._detailed
				then self._appearance.DetailedPivot(plant, position, yaw)
				else CornLayout.PivotForPlant(plant, position, yaw)
		)
		plant.Parent = chunk.Folder
		chunk.Count += 1
		self._plantCount += 1
		created += 1
	end
	if self._folder then
		self._folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", self._plantCount)
	end
	self:_updateOverview()
end

function CornController:_step(delta: number)
	self._pollElapsed += delta
	if self._pollElapsed >= POLL_SEC then
		self._pollElapsed = 0
		local character = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
			self:_reconcile(root)
			local torches = self._map and self._map:FindFirstChild("TorchMarkers")
			if torches then
				for _, torch in torches:GetChildren() do
					if torch:IsA("Model") and torch:GetAttribute("CornTorchOwned") == true then
						local distance = (torch:GetPivot().Position - root.Position).Magnitude
						for _, effect in torch:GetDescendants() do
							if effect:IsA("Fire") then
								effect.Enabled = self._torchesEnabled ~= false and distance < 220
							elseif effect:IsA("PointLight") then
								effect.Enabled = self._torchesEnabled ~= false and distance < 90
							elseif effect:IsA("BasePart") and effect.Name == "Flame" then
								effect.LocalTransparencyModifier = if self._torchesEnabled
										== false
									then 1
									else math.clamp((distance - 240) / 80, 0, 1)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		else
			self:_clearChunks()
		end
	end
	self:_createBatch()
end

function CornController:SetLightingMode(mode: string?)
	local enabled = mode ~= "easy"
	if self._torchesEnabled ~= enabled then
		self._torchesEnabled = enabled
		self._pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
	end
end

function CornController:Init(context: any)
	self._torchesEnabled = true
	self._enabled = RunService:IsStudio()
		and context.Config.Environment == "DEV"
		and (
			context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "solo_local"
			or context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "team_local"
		)
end

function CornController:Start()
	if not self._enabled or self._connection then
		return
	end
	self._connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta: number)
		self:_step(delta)
	end)
end

function CornController:Destroy()
	self._enabled = false
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
	self:_clearInputs()
end

return CornController

--!strict

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local CornLayout = require(
	ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("CornLayout")
)

local CornBackdropController = { Name = "CornBackdropController", Order = 45 }
local PROJECT_ID = "children_of_corn"
local FOLDER_NAME = "CornClientBackdrop"
local STRIDE = 2
local MAX_PLANTS = 20000
local DETAILED_MAX_PLANTS = 30000
local CLONE_BUDGET = 18
local TIME_BUDGET = 0.002
local POLL_SEC = 1

local function owned(item: Instance): boolean
	return item:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") == true
		and item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
end

local function ownedTree(folder: Instance): boolean
	if not owned(folder) then
		return false
	end
	for _, item in folder:GetDescendants() do
		if not owned(item) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function staticArt(template: Instance): boolean
	for _, item in template:GetDescendants() do
		if
			item:IsA("LuaSourceContainer")
			or item:IsA("Sound")
			or item:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
			or item:IsA("Beam")
			or item:IsA("Trail")
			or item:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
			or item:IsA("ClickDetector")
			or item:IsA("RemoteEvent")
			or item:IsA("RemoteFunction")
		then
			return false
		end
	end
	return template.Archivable
end

function CornBackdropController:_warn(message: string)
	if self._lastWarning ~= message then
		self._lastWarning = message
		warn("[CornBackdropController] " .. message)
	end
end

function CornBackdropController:_bridge(folder: Folder): boolean
	local renderer = self._renderer
	return renderer ~= nil
		and typeof(renderer.UseBackdropReady) == "function"
		and renderer:UseBackdropReady(folder) == true
end

function CornBackdropController:_restoreOriginals()
	for part, previous in self._originals do
		if part.Parent then
			part.LocalTransparencyModifier = previous
		end
	end
	table.clear(self._originals)
end

function CornBackdropController:_clear()
	self._epoch += 1
	local folder = self._folder
	if folder and owned(folder) then
		self:_bridge(folder)
		folder:SetAttribute("Ready", false)
	end
	self:_restoreOriginals()
	if folder then
		if ownedTree(folder) then
			folder:Destroy()
		else
			self:_warn(
				"Changed ownership or foreign backdrop content was preserved; saved overview restored"
			)
		end
	end
	self._folder = nil
	self._map = nil
	self._field = nil
	self._template = nil
	self._exclusions = nil
	self._signature = nil
	self._ready = false
	self._count = 0
	self._detailed = false
	self._detailedTemplates = nil
end

function CornBackdropController:_publish(): boolean
	local folder, map = self._folder, self._map
	if not folder or not map or folder.Parent ~= map or not owned(folder) then
		return false
	end
	local overview = map:FindFirstChild("EditorFieldOverview")
	if
		not overview
		or not overview:IsA("Folder")
		or overview:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
		or overview:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		self:_warn("Unrecognized saved overview was preserved; backdrop not published")
		return false
	end
	local originals = overview:GetChildren()
	for _, part in originals do
		if
			not part:IsA("BasePart")
			or part:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
			or part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_warn("Foreign saved overview content was preserved; backdrop not published")
			return false
		end
	end
	-- Bridge clears the old near-field mask before we capture its exact original LTM.
	-- No yield between bridge, capture/hide and publication.
	if not self:_bridge(folder) then
		self:_warn("Near-field backdrop bridge unavailable; saved overview preserved")
		return false
	end
	for _, item in originals do
		local part = item :: BasePart
		self._originals[part] = part.LocalTransparencyModifier
		part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
	end
	self._ready = true
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", self._count)
	folder:SetAttribute("Ready", true)
	return true
end

function CornBackdropController:_resolveInputs(): boolean
	if not self._renderer or typeof(self._renderer.UseBackdropReady) ~= "function" then
		self:_clear()
		self:_warn("Near-field backdrop bridge unavailable; saved overview preserved")
		return false
	end
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	local field = if map then map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone") else nil
	local art = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CornRuntimeArt")
	local template = if art then art:FindFirstChild("CornPlantTemplate") else nil
	if template and template:IsA("Model") then
		self:_clear()
		self:_warn(
			"Backdrop needs a prepared BasePart template compatible with near-field coverage; saved overview preserved"
		)
		return false
	end
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("Asmr_Base")
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("ASMR_Models")
		or not field
		or not field:IsA("BasePart")
		or field.CFrame.UpVector:Dot(Vector3.yAxis) < 0.9999
		or field.Size.X <= 0
		or field.Size.Z <= 0
		or not art
		or not art:IsA("Folder")
		or art:GetAttribute("CornRuntimeArtOwned") ~= true
		or art:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or not template
		or not template:IsA("BasePart")
		or template:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
		or not staticArt(template)
	then
		self:_clear()
		self:_warn(
			"Owned horizontal field and prepared static art unavailable; saved overview preserved"
		)
		return false
	end
	local detailed = map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"
	local templates, appearance = self._detailedTemplates, self._appearance
	if detailed and not templates then
		if self._detailPreparing then
			return false
		end
		self._detailPreparing = true
		local epoch = self._epoch
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			local module = require(
				ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared")
					:WaitForChild("Game")
					:WaitForChild("CornAppearance")
			)
			return { Appearance = module, Templates = module.DetailedTemplates() }
		end)
		self._detailPreparing = false
		if
			self._epoch ~= epoch
			or not map.Parent
			or map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") ~= "B"
		then
			return false
		end
		if not ok then
			self:_warn(
				"Detailed backdrop unavailable; saved overview preserved: " .. tostring(result)
			)
			return false
		end
		templates, appearance = result.Templates, result.Appearance
	end
	local exclusions = CornLayout.ReadExclusions(map, field)
	local bounds, size = CornLayout.Bounds(template)
	local signature = exclusions.Signature
		.. "/template/"
		.. tostring(bounds)
		.. "/"
		.. tostring(size)
		.. (if detailed then "/variant/B" else "")
	local folder = self._folder
	if
		self._map == map
		and self._field == field
		and self._template == template
		and self._signature == signature
		and folder
		and folder.Parent == map
		and owned(folder)
		and folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
		and folder:GetAttribute("Ready") == self._ready
		and (self._detailed == true) == detailed
	then
		return true
	end
	self:_clear()
	if map:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME) then
		self:_warn("Existing CornMap/CornClientBackdrop was preserved; no replacement attempted")
		return false
	end
	if self._failedSignature == signature then
		return false
	end
	local minColumn, maxColumn, minRow, maxRow = CornLayout.GetCellBounds(field)
	minColumn, minRow = math.ceil(minColumn / STRIDE) * STRIDE, math.ceil(minRow / STRIDE) * STRIDE
	maxColumn, maxRow =
		math.floor(maxColumn / STRIDE) * STRIDE, math.floor(maxRow / STRIDE) * STRIDE
	local candidateCount = (math.floor((maxColumn - minColumn) / STRIDE) + 1)
		* (math.floor((maxRow - minRow) / STRIDE) + 1)
	local maxPlants = if detailed then DETAILED_MAX_PLANTS else MAX_PLANTS
	if candidateCount > maxPlants or candidateCount <= 0 then
		self:_warn(
			"Full-field grid exceeds the " .. maxPlants .. " plant cap; saved overview preserved"
		)
		return false
	end
	self._map, self._field, self._template = map, field, template
	self._detailed, self._detailedTemplates, self._appearance = detailed, templates, appearance
	self._exclusions, self._signature = exclusions, signature
	self._minColumn, self._maxColumn = minColumn, maxColumn
	self._minRow, self._maxRow = minRow, maxRow
	self._column, self._row = minColumn, minRow
	self._fieldFrame = field.CFrame
	self._fieldSize = field.Size
	self._fieldYaw = math.atan2(-field.CFrame.LookVector.X, -field.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = FOLDER_NAME
	folder:SetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("CornEditorOverview", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT_ID)
	folder:SetAttribute("Ready", false)
	folder:SetAttribute("Stride", STRIDE)
	folder:SetAttribute("DetailStride", STRIDE * CornLayout.SpacingFor(field))
	folder:SetAttribute("MaxPlants", maxPlants)
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	if detailed then
		folder:SetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant", "B")
		folder:SetAttribute("HarvestCornLod", "Far")
	end
	folder.Parent = map
	self._folder = folder
	self._lastWarning = ""
	return true
end

function CornBackdropController:_advance()
	self._column += STRIDE
	if self._column > self._maxColumn then
		self._column = self._minColumn
		self._row += STRIDE
	end
end

function CornBackdropController:_buildStep()
	local folder, field, template, exclusions =
		self._folder, self._field, self._template, self._exclusions
	if not folder or not field or not template or not exclusions or self._ready then
		return
	end
	if
		folder.Parent ~= self._map
		or not owned(folder)
		or field.CFrame ~= self._fieldFrame
		or field.Size ~= self._fieldSize
		or (self._map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B") ~= (self._detailed == true)
	then
		self:_clear()
		self._pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
		return
	end
	local epoch, start = self._epoch, self._clock()
	local created = 0
	local maxPlants = if self._detailed then DETAILED_MAX_PLANTS else MAX_PLANTS
	while
		self._epoch == epoch
		and self._row <= self._maxRow
		and created < CLONE_BUDGET
		and self._count < maxPlants
		and self._clock() - start < TIME_BUDGET
	do
		local column, row = self._column, self._row
		self:_advance()
		local position = CornLayout.CellPosition(field, column, row)
		if CornLayout.IsExcluded(position, exclusions) then
			continue
		end
		position = CornLayout.TrailEdgePosition(position, exclusions)
		local source = if self._detailed
			then self._detailedTemplates.Far[self._appearance.Variety(column, row)]
			else template
		local plant = source:Clone()
		if not plant then
			error("Prepared backdrop plant could not be cloned")
		end
		plant.Name = string.format("Far_%d_%d", column, row)
		local parts = plant:GetDescendants()
		table.insert(parts, plant)
		for _, item in parts do
			item:SetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned", true)
			item:SetAttribute("CornEditorOverview", true)
			item:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT_ID)
			item:SetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned", nil)
			if item:IsA("BasePart") then
				item.Anchored = true
				item.CanCollide = false
				item.CanTouch = false
				item.CanQuery = false
				item.CastShadow = self._detailed == true
			end
		end
		CornLayout.ApplyVariation(plant, column, row)
		local yaw = CornLayout.CellYaw(column, row) + self._fieldYaw
		plant:PivotTo(
			if self._detailed
				then self._appearance.DetailedPivot(plant, position, yaw)
				else CornLayout.PivotForPlant(plant, position, yaw)
		)
		plant.Parent = folder
		created += 1
		self._count += 1
	end
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", self._count)
	folder:SetAttribute("LastFrameClones", created)
	folder:SetAttribute("LastFrameSeconds", self._clock() - start)
	if self._row > self._maxRow then
		if not self:_publish() then
			local failed = self._signature
			self:_clear()
			self._failedSignature = failed
		end
	end
end

function CornBackdropController:_step(delta: number)
	self._pollElapsed += delta
	if self._pollElapsed >= POLL_SEC then
		self._pollElapsed = 0
		self:_resolveInputs()
	end
	self:_buildStep()
end

function CornBackdropController:Init(context: any)
	self._enabled = RunService:IsStudio()
		and context.Config.Environment == "DEV"
		and (
			context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "solo_local"
			or context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "team_local"
		)
	self._renderer = context.Controllers.CornController
	self._connection = nil
	self._clock = os.clock
	self._epoch = 0
	self._originals = {}
	self._ready = false
	self._count = 0
	self._lastWarning = ""
	self._pollElapsed = math.huge
	self._failedSignature = nil
end

function CornBackdropController:Start()
	if not self._enabled or self._connection then
		return
	end
	self._connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta: number)
		local ok, problem = pcall(self._step, self, delta)
		if not ok then
			local failed = self._signature
			self:_clear()
			self._failedSignature = failed
			self:_warn("Backdrop build failed; saved overview restored: " .. tostring(problem))
		end
	end)
end

function CornBackdropController:Destroy()
	self._enabled = false
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
	self:_clear()
	self._renderer = nil
end

return CornBackdropController

--!strict
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local CornWindController = { Name = "CornWindController", Order = 55 }
local PROJECT_ID = "children_of_corn"
local BUCKET_SIZE = 6
local RADIUS = 5
local MONSTER_VIEW_RADIUS = 70
local UPDATE_SEC = 1 / 12
local SELECT_SEC = 0.2
local RESOLVE_SEC = 0.5
local INDEX_BUDGET = 64
local INDEX_SECONDS = 0.001
local ACTOR_LIMIT = 2
local SCAN_LIMIT = 128
local PART_LIMIT = 32
local TRAIL_SEC = 0.3
local MAX_PARTS_PER_PLANT = 8
local ANGLE = math.rad(3)

local function disconnect(connections: { RBXScriptConnection })
	for _, connection in connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(connections)
end

local function decorative(part: BasePart): boolean
	return part.Anchored and not part.CanCollide and not part.CanTouch and not part.CanQuery
end

local function bucketKey(x: number, z: number): string
	return tostring(x) .. ":" .. tostring(z)
end

function CornWindController:_ownedLayer(folder: Instance, kind: string): boolean
	return folder:IsA("Folder")
		and folder.Parent == self._map
		and folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
		and (
			if kind == "near"
				then folder.Name == "CornClientPlants" and folder:GetAttribute(
					"CornClientRendererOwned"
				) == true
				else folder.Name == "CornClientBackdrop" and folder:GetAttribute(
					"CornClientBackdropOwned"
				) == true and folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
		)
end

function CornWindController:_validEntry(entry: any): boolean
	local layer = entry.Layer
	if
		self._layers[layer.Kind] ~= layer
		or not self:_ownedLayer(layer.Folder, layer.Kind)
		or entry.Plant.Parent ~= entry.Parent
	then
		return false
	end
	if layer.Kind == "near" then
		if
			entry.Parent.Parent ~= layer.Folder
			or entry.Plant.Name ~= "Corn"
			or entry.Plant:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
		then
			return false
		end
	elseif
		entry.Plant:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") ~= true
		or entry.Plant:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		return false
	end
	for _, saved in entry.Parts do
		if not decorative(saved.Part) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function CornWindController:_restore(entry: any)
	if not entry.Moved then
		return
	end
	-- Removed copies can still be unparented Instances. Restore their exact frames
	-- before forgetting them; destroyed copies need no recovery.
	for _, saved in entry.Parts do
		pcall(function()
			saved.Part.CFrame = saved.Frame
		end)
	end
	entry.Moved = false
end

function CornWindController:_restoreActive()
	for entry in self._active do
		self:_restore(entry)
	end
	self._active = {}
	self._selected = {}
end

function CornWindController:_remove(layer: any, plant: Instance)
	local entry = layer.Entries[plant]
	if not entry then
		return
	end
	self:_restore(entry)
	self._active[entry] = nil
	layer.Entries[plant] = nil
	layer.Count -= 1
	local bucket = layer.Buckets[entry.Bucket]
	if bucket then
		bucket[entry] = nil
		if next(bucket) == nil then
			layer.Buckets[entry.Bucket] = nil
		end
	end
	local group = layer.Groups[entry.Parent]
	if group then
		group.Entries[plant] = nil
	end
	self._selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
end

function CornWindController:_enqueue(layer: any, plant: Instance, parent: Instance)
	self._pendingTail += 1
	self._pending[self._pendingTail] = { Layer = layer, Plant = plant, Parent = parent }
end

function CornWindController:_register(job: any)
	local layer, plant, parent = job.Layer, job.Plant, job.Parent
	if
		self._layers[layer.Kind] ~= layer
		or layer.Entries[plant]
		or not self:_ownedLayer(layer.Folder, layer.Kind)
		or plant.Parent ~= parent
	then
		return
	end
	if layer.Kind == "near" then
		if
			not layer.Groups[parent]
			or plant.Name ~= "Corn"
			or plant:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
		then
			return
		end
	elseif
		not plant.Name:match("^Far_%-?%d+_%-?%d+$")
		or plant:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") ~= true
		or plant:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		return
	end
	local detailed = self._map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"
	local limit = if layer.Kind == "near"
		then (if detailed then 8192 else 4096)
		else (if detailed then 30000 else 20000)
	if layer.Count >= limit then
		return
	end
	local parts, frame, size = {}, nil, nil
	if plant:IsA("BasePart") then
		if not decorative(plant) then
			return
		end
		table.insert(parts, { Part = plant, Frame = plant.CFrame })
		frame, size = plant.CFrame, plant.Size
	elseif plant:IsA("Model") then
		for _, part in plant:GetDescendants() do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				if not decorative(part) or #parts >= MAX_PARTS_PER_PLANT then
					return
				end
				table.insert(parts, { Part = part, Frame = part.CFrame })
			end
		end
		if #parts == 0 then
			return
		end
		frame, size = plant:GetBoundingBox()
	else
		return
	end
	local position = frame.Position
	local key =
		bucketKey(math.floor(position.X / BUCKET_SIZE), math.floor(position.Z / BUCKET_SIZE))
	local entry = {
		Layer = layer,
		Plant = plant,
		Parent = parent,
		Parts = parts,
		Position = position,
		Base = position - Vector3.new(0, size.Y / 2, 0),
		Bucket = key,
		Phase = (position.X * 0.17 + position.Z * 0.11) % (math.pi * 2),
		Moved = false,
	}
	layer.Entries[plant] = entry
	layer.Count += 1
	if not layer.Buckets[key] then
		layer.Buckets[key] = {}
	end
	layer.Buckets[key][entry] = true
	if layer.Kind == "near" then
		layer.Groups[parent].Entries[plant] = true
	end
	self._selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
end

function CornWindController:_indexBatch()
	local began, count = self._clock(), 0
	while
		self._pendingHead <= self._pendingTail
		and count < INDEX_BUDGET
		and self._clock() - began < INDEX_SECONDS
	do
		local job = self._pending[self._pendingHead]
		self._pending[self._pendingHead] = nil
		self._pendingHead += 1
		self:_register(job)
		count += 1
	end
	if self._pendingHead > self._pendingTail then
		self._pending, self._pendingHead, self._pendingTail = {}, 1, 0
	end
end

function CornWindController:_removeGroup(layer: any, folder: Instance)
	local group = layer.Groups[folder]
	if not group then
		return
	end
	disconnect(group.Connections)
	for plant in group.Entries do
		self:_remove(layer, plant)
	end
	layer.Groups[folder] = nil
end

function CornWindController:_bindGroup(layer: any, folder: Instance)
	if
		layer.Groups[folder]
		or not folder:IsA("Folder")
		or folder.Parent ~= layer.Folder
		or not folder.Name:match("^Chunk_")
	then
		return
	end
	local group = { Connections = {}, Entries = {} }
	layer.Groups[folder] = group
	table.insert(
		group.Connections,
		folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(plant)
			self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		group.Connections,
		folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(plant)
			self:_remove(layer, plant)
		end)
	)
	for _, plant in folder:GetChildren() do
		self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
	end
end

function CornWindController:_detachLayer(kind: string)
	local layer = self._layers[kind]
	if not layer then
		return
	end
	for _, group in layer.Groups do
		disconnect(group.Connections)
	end
	disconnect(layer.Connections)
	for _, entry in layer.Entries do
		self:_restore(entry)
		self._active[entry] = nil
	end
	self._layers[kind] = nil
	self._selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
end

function CornWindController:_bindLayer(folder: Instance?, kind: string)
	local previous = self._layers[kind]
	if previous and previous.Folder == folder and self:_ownedLayer(previous.Folder, kind) then
		return
	end
	self:_detachLayer(kind)
	if not folder or not self:_ownedLayer(folder, kind) then
		return
	end
	local layer = {
		Kind = kind,
		Folder = folder,
		Connections = {},
		Entries = {},
		Buckets = {},
		Groups = {},
		Count = 0,
	}
	self._layers[kind] = layer
	table.insert(
		layer.Connections,
		folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(plant)
			if kind == "near" then
				self:_bindGroup(layer, plant)
			else
				self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
			end
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		layer.Connections,
		folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(plant)
			if kind == "near" then
				self:_removeGroup(layer, plant)
			else
				self:_remove(layer, plant)
			end
		end)
	)
	for _, attribute in
		{
			"corn_project_id",
			if kind == "near" then "CornClientRendererOwned" else "CornClientBackdropOwned",
			"Ready",
		}
	do
		table.insert(
			layer.Connections,
			folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(function()
				if not self:_ownedLayer(folder, kind) then
					self:_detachLayer(kind)
				elseif kind == "far" and folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true then
					folder:SetAttribute("CornWindAnimated", 0)
					for entry in self._active do
						if entry.Layer == layer then
							self:_restore(entry)
							self._active[entry] = nil
						end
					end
				end
				self._selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
			end)
		)
	end
	for _, plant in folder:GetChildren() do
		if kind == "near" then
			self:_bindGroup(layer, plant)
		else
			self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
		end
	end
end

function CornWindController:_clearMap()
	self._monsterSamples = {}
	self:_detachLayer("near")
	self:_detachLayer("far")
	disconnect(self._mapConnections)
	self._map = nil
	self._pending, self._pendingHead, self._pendingTail = {}, 1, 0
	self:_restoreActive()
end

function CornWindController:_resolveMap()
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("Asmr_Base")
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("ASMR_Models")
	then
		self:_clearMap()
		return
	end
	if map ~= self._map then
		self:_clearMap()
		self._map = map
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				if self._map == map and map.Parent ~= Workspace then
					self:_clearMap()
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map:GetAttributeChangedSignal("corn_project_id"):Connect(function()
				if self._map == map and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID then
					self:_clearMap()
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map.ChildAdded:Connect(function(item)
				if item.Name == "CornClientPlants" then
					self:_bindLayer(item, "near")
				elseif item.Name == "CornClientBackdrop" then
					self:_bindLayer(item, "far")
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(item)
				for kind, layer in self._layers do
					if layer.Folder == item then
						self:_detachLayer(kind)
					end
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	self:_bindLayer(map:FindFirstChild("CornClientPlants"), "near")
	self:_bindLayer(map:FindFirstChild("CornClientBackdrop"), "far")
end

local function horizontalDistanceSquared(a: Vector3, b: Vector3): number
	local delta = a - b
	return delta.X * delta.X + delta.Z * delta.Z
end

local function visible(entry: any, camera: Camera): boolean
	if
		horizontalDistanceSquared(entry.Position, camera.CFrame.Position)
		> MONSTER_VIEW_RADIUS ^ 2
	then
		return false
	end
	local shown = false
	for _, saved in entry.Parts do
		if saved.Part.Transparency < 0.99 and saved.Part.LocalTransparencyModifier < 0.99 then
			shown = true
			break
		end
	end
	if not shown then
		return false
	end
	local screen, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(entry.Position)
	return onScreen and screen.Z > 0
end

function CornWindController:_actorCandidates(
	camera: Camera,
	position: Vector3,
	front: Vector3?,
	active: any
): { any }
	local result, scanned = {}, 0
	for _, kind in { "near", "far" } do
		local layer = self._layers[kind]
		if
			not layer
			or not self:_ownedLayer(layer.Folder, kind)
			or (kind == "far" and layer.Folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true)
		then
			continue
		end
		for x = math.floor((position.X - RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE), math.floor((position.X + RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE) do
			for z = math.floor((position.Z - RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE), math.floor((position.Z + RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE) do
				for entry in layer.Buckets[bucketKey(x, z)] or {} do
					scanned += 1
					if scanned > SCAN_LIMIT then
						break
					end
					local delta = entry.Position - position
					local distance = delta.X * delta.X + delta.Z * delta.Z
					local ahead = front == nil
						or distance <= 1.8 ^ 2
						or delta.X * front.X + delta.Z * front.Z >= 0
					if
						distance <= RADIUS ^ 2
						and ahead
						and not active[entry]
						and math.abs(position.Y - entry.Base.Y) <= 7
						and self:_validEntry(entry)
						and visible(entry, camera)
					then
						table.insert(result, { Entry = entry, Distance = distance })
					end
				end
				if scanned > SCAN_LIMIT then
					break
				end
			end
			if scanned > SCAN_LIMIT then
				break
			end
		end
		if scanned > SCAN_LIMIT then
			break
		end
	end
	self._lastScanned += math.min(scanned, SCAN_LIMIT)
	table.sort(result, function(a, b)
		return a.Distance < b.Distance
	end)
	local selected = {}
	for index = 1, math.min(ACTOR_LIMIT, #result) do
		table.insert(selected, result[index].Entry)
	end
	return selected
end

function CornWindController:_playerPosition(): Vector3?
	local character = self._player and self._player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		self._playerRoot, self._previousPlayer, self._playerTrail = nil, nil, 0
		return nil
	end
	if self._playerRoot ~= root then
		self:_restoreActive()
		self._playerRoot, self._previousPlayer, self._playerTrail = root, nil, 0
	end
	local position = root.Position
	if
		humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05
		or (
			self._previousPlayer
			and horizontalDistanceSquared(position, self._previousPlayer) > 0.01
		)
	then
		self._playerTrail = self._time + TRAIL_SEC
	end
	self._previousPlayer = position
	return if self._playerTrail > self._time then position else nil
end

function CornWindController:_monsterPosition(): Vector3?
	local runtime = self._map and self._map:FindFirstChild("CornRoundRuntime")
	local nearest, nearestRoot, distance = nil, nil, math.huge
	for index = 1, 3 do
		local monster = runtime
			and runtime:IsA("Folder")
			and runtime:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
			and runtime:FindFirstChild(if index == 1 then "Monster" else "Monster" .. index)
		local root = monster and monster:FindFirstChild("Root")
		local state = monster and monster:GetAttribute("HuntState")
		if
			not monster
			or not monster:IsA("Model")
			or monster:GetAttribute("CornMonsterOwned") ~= true
			or monster:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
			or monster:GetAttribute("MonsterRigVersion") ~= 1
			or monster:GetAttribute("MonsterIndex") ~= index
			or not root
			or not root:IsA("BasePart")
			or (state ~= "patrol" and state ~= "chase")
		then
			self._monsterSamples[index] = nil
			continue
		end
		local sample = self._monsterSamples[index]
		if not sample or sample.root ~= root then
			sample = { root = root, previous = root.Position, untilAt = 0 }
			self._monsterSamples[index] = sample
		end
		local position = root.Position
		if horizontalDistanceSquared(position, sample.previous) > 0.01 then
			sample.untilAt = self._time + TRAIL_SEC
		end
		sample.previous = position
		local candidate = if self._playerRoot
			then horizontalDistanceSquared(position, self._playerRoot.Position)
			else math.huge
		if sample.untilAt > self._time and candidate < distance then
			nearest, nearestRoot, distance = sample, root, candidate
		end
	end
	self._monsterRoot = nearestRoot
	self._previousMonster = if nearest then nearest.previous else nil
	self._monsterTrail = if nearest then nearest.untilAt else 0
	return if nearest then nearest.previous else nil
end

function CornWindController:_select(camera: Camera)
	local chosen, active = {}, {}
	self._lastScanned = 0
	local function add(position: Vector3?, front: Vector3?)
		if not position then
			return
		end
		for _, entry in self:_actorCandidates(camera, position, front, active) do
			active[entry] = true
			table.insert(chosen, entry)
		end
	end
	add(self:_playerPosition(), camera.CFrame.LookVector)
	if self._playerRoot then
		add(self:_monsterPosition(), nil)
	end
	for entry in self._active do
		if not active[entry] then
			self:_restore(entry)
		end
	end
	self._active, self._selected = active, chosen
end

function CornWindController:_diagnostics(near: number, far: number)
	for kind, layer in self._layers do
		if self:_ownedLayer(layer.Folder, kind) then
			local count = if kind == "near" then near else far
			if layer.Folder:GetAttribute("CornWindAnimated") ~= count then
				layer.Folder:SetAttribute("CornWindAnimated", count)
			end
			if layer.Folder:GetAttribute("CornWindMode") ~= (self._mode or "off") then
				layer.Folder:SetAttribute("CornWindMode", self._mode or "off")
			end
		end
	end
end

function CornWindController:_animate(camera: Camera)
	local writes, near, far = 0, 0, 0
	for _, entry in self._selected do
		if writes + #entry.Parts > PART_LIMIT then
			break
		end
		if
			not self._active[entry]
			or not self:_validEntry(entry)
			or (entry.Layer.Kind == "far" and entry.Layer.Folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true)
			or not visible(entry, camera)
		then
			self:_restore(entry)
			continue
		end
		local phase = entry.Phase
		local x = ANGLE * 0.75 * math.sin(self._time * 7 + phase)
		local z = ANGLE * 0.35 * math.sin(self._time * 5 + phase * 1.4)
		local transform = CFrame.new(entry.Base) * CFrame.Angles(x, 0, z) * CFrame.new(-entry.Base)
		for _, saved in entry.Parts do
			saved.Part.CFrame = transform * saved.Frame
		end
		entry.Moved = true
		writes += #entry.Parts
		if entry.Layer.Kind == "near" then
			near += 1
		else
			far += 1
		end
	end
	self._lastWrites, self._lastNear, self._lastFar = writes, near, far
	self:_diagnostics(near, far)
end

function CornWindController:SetMode(mode: string?)
	local nextMode = if mode == "easy" or mode == "medium" or mode == "hard" then mode else nil
	if self._mode == nextMode then
		return
	end
	self:_restoreActive()
	self._mode = nextMode
	self._previousPlayer, self._previousMonster = nil, nil
	self._monsterSamples = {}
	self._playerTrail, self._monsterTrail = 0, 0
	self._updateElapsed, self._selectElapsed = UPDATE_SEC, SELECT_SEC
	self._lastWrites, self._lastNear, self._lastFar = 0, 0, 0
	self:_diagnostics(0, 0)
end

function CornWindController:_step(delta: number)
	self._time += math.clamp(delta, 0, 0.25)
	self._resolveElapsed += delta
	if self._resolveElapsed >= RESOLVE_SEC then
		self._resolveElapsed = 0
		self:_resolveMap()
	end
	self:_indexBatch()
	if not self._mode then
		return
	end
	self._updateElapsed += delta
	self._selectElapsed += delta
	if self._updateElapsed < UPDATE_SEC then
		return
	end
	self._updateElapsed = 0
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if
		not camera
		or not self._map
		or self._map.Parent ~= Workspace
		or self._map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		self:_restoreActive()
		return
	end
	if self._selectElapsed >= SELECT_SEC then
		self._selectElapsed = 0
		self:_select(camera)
	end
	self:_animate(camera)
end

function CornWindController:Init(context: any)
	self._enabled = RunService:IsStudio()
		and context.Config.Environment == "DEV"
		and (
			context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "solo_local"
			or context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "team_local"
		)
	self._connection, self._player = nil, Players.LocalPlayer
	self._clock = os.clock
	self._map, self._mode = nil, nil
	self._layers, self._mapConnections, self._active, self._selected = {}, {}, {}, {}
	self._pending, self._pendingHead, self._pendingTail = {}, 1, 0
	self._time, self._resolveElapsed, self._updateElapsed, self._selectElapsed =
		0, RESOLVE_SEC, UPDATE_SEC, SELECT_SEC
	self._lastWrites, self._lastNear, self._lastFar, self._lastScanned = 0, 0, 0, 0
	self._previousPlayer, self._previousMonster, self._playerRoot, self._monsterRoot =
		nil, nil, nil, nil
	self._playerTrail, self._monsterTrail = 0, 0
	self._monsterSamples = {}
end

function CornWindController:Start()
	if not self._enabled or self._connection then
		return
	end
	self:_resolveMap()
	self._connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
		self:_step(delta)
	end)
end

function CornWindController:Destroy()
	self:SetMode(nil)
	self._enabled = false
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
	self:_clearMap()
end

return CornWindController
